Part 3: Questions 21-27 Complete the notes below. Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS for each answer.
Research proposal – key elements • An effective (21) – keep it brief • Abstract – i.e. (22) of my research • Introduction and/ or (23) – relevant books and articles – show similarities to my theory but also how it is (24) • Methods – work plan: outline (25) ; participants, samples etc. • Discussion (of (26) ) – significance of findings and future use; also any weaknesses • (27) – participants’ consent and approval from Ethics Committee
